snippet.title: Kung-Fu Master Returns (WINE) Levels 1-2 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Originally developed for Windows 32 bits in Blitz Basic 2D, back in 2002/2003.

You can download from https://archive.org/details/kfmr09.

It should work on modern Windows 10, but here it is shown running via Linux on Wine.

Troubleshooting: Game uses native full screen 400x300 resolution, which may not be supported depending on the system. If that's the case, edit the option "Resolution = 4" for 800x600 full screen, or "Resolution = 1" for 400x300 windowed.

Custom options: To enable shadows, open config.ini, and edit the option "Shadow Type = 0".

Note: The game originally features a MIDI track on the background. I was unable to make it work on this Linux+WINE setup.
